display_long_description:
Bowl for your life — Zombie Strike VR turns classic 10-pin bowling into an undead horror showdown built for Meta Quest.

🧟 NINE GAME MODES
• Classic: Full 10-frame game — chase the perfect 300 massacre
• Challenge: Brutal undead pin setups, splits & washouts
• Speed Bowl: Drop the most zombies against the clock
• Practice: Free throw, no pressure
• Tournament: Spend scrap to enter, beat rival survivors
• Extreme: Shambling moving targets, 2x rewards
• Career: Rise from Survivor to Apocalypse Legend
• Trick Shot & Spare Challenge: bonus-scrap objectives

💀 NINE CURSED BALLS
Fire Skull, Frost Wraith, Galaxy Reaper, Golden Idol, Hex Orb, Plasma Soul, Inferno Core, Thunder Crypt & Cosmic Doom — each with haunting trails.

🪦 NINE HAUNTED LANES
Neon Necropolis, Space Tomb, Drowned Graveyard, Retro Horror, Lava Pit, Frozen Grave, Cursed Jungle, Blood Sunset & Midnight Cemetery.

⚡ FEATURES
• Bone-crunching pin physics & undead knockdowns
• Power-ups: Guide Line, Slow Motion, Skull Magnet, Second Chance
• Daily & weekly challenges, Lucky Spin, Season Pass, login bonuses
• Global leaderboards, custom ball creator & alley customization
• 4 difficulty levels & multiple oil patterns for real bowling depth

Arcade horror bowling — grab your ball, brace for the horde, and STRIKE!
